summary: Meta's Marketing API for creating, managing and reporting on ads across Facebook and Instagram.
access_note: Create a Meta business app; Standard access works for your own ad accounts, Advanced access needs App Review to manage others' accounts.
blocker_note: Managing other users' ad accounts requires Advanced access via App Review (and business verification).

evidence.quote: or pass a pre-obtained access token if you manage your own token lifecycle
If your app is only managing your ad account, standard access to the ads_read and ads_management permissions are sufficient
Advanced access must be approved through the App Review process on an individual permission and feature basis
The Graph API is the primary way to get data into and out of the Facebook platform
The ads MCP server is a Meta-hosted Model Context Protocol

notes: Marketing API is Graph API based (HTTP). OAuth inferred from MCP blog (Facebook Login for Business) rather than a dedicated auth page; tier names reportedly renamed to Limited/Full Access.

review.reason: Original quotes contained an apostrophe or hidden characters that broke matching; replaced with plain sentences from the same pages.
